tools.name: generate_changelog
tools.description: Build a structured changelog entry by reading commits between two git refs from GitHub, then upsert it into the Notion Changelog database.

fromTag.description: Optional previous tag to compare against. Defaults to the prior tag.

tools.name: publish_release
tools.description: Read a Notion changelog page and publish the corresponding GitHub release with the page's notes.

pageId.description: Notion page ID of the changelog row

tools.name: sync_api_reference
tools.description: Fetch an OpenAPI JSON spec from a URL and upsert each endpoint into the Notion API Reference database.

specUrl.description: Public URL to an OpenAPI 3.x JSON spec

tools.name: query_release
tools.description: Look up a release by tag in the Notion Changelog database and return a summary of features, fixes, and breaking changes.

tag.description: Release tag to look up, e.g. 'v1.4.0'
